headline: A 2017 executive order calls for a review of national monument designations made under the Antiquities Act.
what_it_does: The Antiquities Act is the law that lets presidents set aside federal land as national monuments. Based on its title, this order directs a review of past designations made under that law. No summary was provided, so details such as which monuments are covered, who does the review, and what may happen afterward are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: People and groups who use, work on, or live near national monument lands
who_it_affects.how: The review could lead to recommendations about existing monument designations, but the title alone does not say what changes, if any, would follow.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 26, 2017; the title does not state an effective date or review deadlines.
